Applications & Components → Comma → Macros, **Drawing** tab.

## <img class="tool-icon" src="../../../../images/tekla/tools/macros/uswitchdimensiontag.svg" alt="" width="24" height="24" style="display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;background:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:1px" /> uSwitchDimensionTag

Select a dimension set and run this repeatedly to cycle its tag position through all 7 positions (left/right upper/middle/lower, plus the per-span middle-lower tag) — one step forward each time.

## <img class="tool-icon" src="../../../../images/tekla/tools/macros/uaddmarkusingappliedproperties.svg" alt="" width="24" height="24" style="display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;background:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:1px" /> uAddMarkUsingAppliedProperties

Adds a mark to the current view using Tekla's "applied properties" mark command.

## <img class="tool-icon" src="../../../../images/tekla/tools/macros/ualignhorizontal.svg" alt="" width="24" height="24" style="display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;background:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:1px" /> <img class="tool-icon" src="../../../../images/tekla/tools/macros/ualignvertical.svg" alt="" width="24" height="24" style="display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;background:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:1px" /> uAlignHorizontal / uAlignVertical

Aligns the active view horizontally or vertically — the same as Tekla's own native align-view commands, available as a one-click macro.

## <img class="tool-icon" src="../../../../images/tekla/tools/macros/ucreaterebarsetdimensions.png" alt="" width="24" height="24" style="display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;background:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:1px" /> uCreateRebarSetDimensions

Adds rebar-set dimension marks to the selected views (or every relevant view, if none are selected) for every reinforcement set group found there.

## <img class="tool-icon" src="../../../../images/tekla/tools/macros/ufreeplaceannotations.png" alt="" width="24" height="24" style="display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;background:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:1px" /> uFreeplaceAnnotations

Switches every annotation object (marks, dimensions, symbols — anything that isn't a view or a model object) in the selected/all views to free placement and rearranges them automatically.

## <img class="tool-icon" src="../../../../images/tekla/tools/macros/ufreeplacearrangedrawing.png" alt="" width="24" height="24" style="display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;background:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:1px" /> uFreeplaceArrangeDrawing

Switches every view on the sheet to free placement and re-arranges the whole drawing layout.

## <img class="tool-icon" src="../../../../images/tekla/tools/macros/umovemarkshorizontaltoperpendicular.png" alt="" width="24" height="24" style="display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;background:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:1px" /> <img class="tool-icon" src="../../../../images/tekla/tools/macros/umovemarksverticaltoperpendicular.png" alt="" width="24" height="24" style="display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;background:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:1px" /> uMoveMarksHorizontalToPerpendicular / uMoveMarksVerticalToPerpendicular

Select one or more marks, then run this to reposition them horizontally or vertically so their leader line reads perpendicular, accounting for the view's own leader-line-extension setting.

## <img class="tool-icon" src="../../../../images/tekla/tools/macros/uopenphasemanager.png" alt="" width="24" height="24" style="display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;background:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:1px" /> uOpenPhaseManager

Opens Tekla's Phase Manager dialog directly to the Phases tab.

## <img class="tool-icon" src="../../../../images/tekla/tools/macros/uopenprojectuda.png" alt="" width="24" height="24" style="display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;background:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:1px" /> uOpenProjectUDA

Same macro as the Modeling-tab one above — opens the Project UDA dialog straight to Classification, available here too since it's useful from a drawing as well.
